column1: # Source-owned production evidence for the LIKE matcher audit.

column5: Scalar LIKE control flow is ported from Go: NULL short-circuit, EvalString coercion, escape-byte compilation, wildcard matching, and utf8mb4_bin character semantics. The explicit like_match_with_collation helper also covers registered general-CI and Unicode-CI wildcard weights; expression-level session selection, pattern-cache state, and warning/error channels remain outside the seed evaluator.

The scalar physical matcher is shared by the seed evaluator; Go's chunk/vectorized allocator and per-row collation state are not represented yet, so this source file remains an explicit partial rather than an unverified claim of vector coverage.
